first_page_excerpt: CAM-56G3 Data brief VD56G3 promodules: Camera module evaluation samples for instant integration of VD56G3 sensor Features • • • • • Order code Description CAM-6G3-073CLR VD56G3 promodule with 73° FoV lens CAM-6G3-084CLR VD56G3 promodule with 84° FoV lens CAM-6G3-152CLR VD56G3 promodule with 152° FoV lens “Promodules”: turnkey camera modules for evaluation: – Including VD56G3 image sensor, lens holder, lens, and plug-and-play flex connection. – Lens focused, glued, and tested in a cleanroom environment using specialized equipment. – Small footprint down to 6.5 mm square. Various lens options: – Ultra-wide-angle lens for wide scene capture (152° DFOV). – Highly compact lens for a thin module (84° DFOV). – General-purpose lens enabling various system setups (73° DFOV).
